newsitem.title: UK: South Brazil features in new sugar freight orders.
newsitem.headline: South Brazil features in new sugar freight orders.

text.p: Business was more subdued at the end of the week on London's sugar freight market but more orders emerged from south Brazil as it geared up for its shipment cycle, shipbrokers said on Friday.
Cargill issued a new order for 13/13,500 tonnes of bulk sugar from Acajutla to US Gulf/Atlantic, specifying prompt to May 20 as the shipment period.
Vitol quoted for 20,000 tonnes in bulk from Maceio to the Black Sea for seven days notice and a further 14,000 tonnes from Santos to the same destination for end May/early June.

Tate & Lyle was open for 17,750/18,500 tonnes of bulk sugar from Bridgetown to London for early June and E D & F Man had a small 4,400-tonne bagged parcel from Santander to Dubai for end-May/early June.
Shipbrokers said Genoc fixed 14,000 tonnes of bagged sugar from Poland to the Red Sea with options of Pakistan and Colombo for prompt shipment dates.
Louis Dreyfus was said to have fixed 13,000 tonnes of bagged sugar from Puerto Quetzal to Colombo with east Africa option. No further details were available.
